== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The remastered virtual slip prints the Grabber icon. The earlier virtual slip and underlying physical Decipher face lack it. The period rulebook also lists a separate Decipher Tentacle erratum. The virtual game clauses still stack the just-played opponent Interrupt with the same three-card limit, cost, -3 and Control immunity.
